# Stokfeed

Stokfeed is an independent financial news and commentary publication covering equities, ETFs, foreign exchange, cryptocurrency and original market research. Articles are informational and not personalized investment advice.

## Important pages
- https://www.stokfeed.us/ — Latest market news and featured research
- https://www.stokfeed.us/nyse.html — NYSE & S&P 500: The latest U.S. equity market reports.
- https://www.stokfeed.us/qqq.html — QQQ: Weekly Nasdaq-100 ETF reporting.
- https://www.stokfeed.us/4x.html — Forex: Major currency movements and exchange-rate reporting.
- https://www.stokfeed.us/crypto.html — Crypto: Digital-asset market reports.
- https://www.stokfeed.us/research.html — Research & Opinion: Independent analysis from the Stokfeed editorial desk.
- https://www.stokfeed.us/sitemap.xml — Complete index of published articles
